ncei:5685375.narrative: The tornado began just south of Alamo and tracked northeast damaging the south side of Alamo before moving into rural areas. Eleven conventional homes, five mobile homes and one commercial building were destroyed. Seventy-three other homes and buildings  were damaged.

ncei:5686231.title: Grigsby, Texas
ncei:5686231.narrative: This was a segment of a tornado which traversed Nacogdoches  and San Augustine Counties.  Damage was mainly forestry however a large did crushed a mobile home with moderate damage.

ncei:5697270.title: Carlsbad, New Mexico
ncei:5697270.narrative: Brief dust whirl tornado reported by vacationing NWS Chaser.

ncei:5698671.title: Spearfish, South Dakota
ncei:5698671.narrative: Brief Touchdown. Moved into Butte County.

ncei:5704394.title: Lincoln, Illinois
ncei:5704394.narrative: The tornado initially touched down near the intersection of I-155 and I-55, about 3.5 miles northwest of Lincoln.  It blew over several semis causing injuries to two drivers.  The drivers were treated and released.  The tornado continued to the east southeast damaging trees, grain bins, and farm equipment near IL Route 121 and county road 1750N.  It crossed IL Route 121 and entered Kickapoo Creek county park, where it did extensive damage to dozens of trees.  Several tree limbs and sheared tree tops were thrown 50 to 100 yards away.  The tornado lifted and dissipated near the east edge of the park.

ncei:5705399.title: Union City, Oklahoma
ncei:5705399.narrative: Tornado B12. See summary at end of May 3rd storm reports.

ncei:5705405.title: Kingfisher, Oklahoma
ncei:5705405.narrative: Tornado B17 (Kingfisher County portion). See summary at end of May 3rd storm reports.

ncei:5643755.title: Cape Canavral Misl S, Florida
ncei:5643755.narrative: A small tornado touched down briefly at the Titan launch Complex at Cape Canaveral AFS. The tornado damaged a trailer and blew down large metel doors off a missle hanger. Two people in the hanger were injured.

ncei:5622320.title: Echo, Alabama
ncei:5622320.narrative: F1 tornado struck a chicken farm at Alabama Highway 27 and Dale County Road 67.  Six of eight chicken houses were destroyed.  Approximately 25,000 chickens were killed.

ncei:10320386.title: Dixon, Illinois
ncei:10320386.narrative: Emergency management reported a tornado at Sterling and Lyons Road east of Dixon. No damage was reported.

ncei:10325229.title: New Bethel, Kentucky
ncei:10325229.narrative: Tornado damaged some homes.  Mobile Home parks was damaged, a McDonald's roof and a Kroger's roof were damaged.

ncei:10327050.title: Arnold, Maryland
ncei:10327050.narrative: A bow-echo, racing well east ahead of the Charles-Prince Georges-west Anne Arundel County mesocyclone, produced a short-lived gustnado/waterspout along the Magothy River in Arnold.  Minor tree and structural damage was noted at two residences, while an automobile was turned around.  The tornado lifted as a waterspout over the Magothy River.

ncei:10330589.title: Adams, Minnesota
ncei:10330589.narrative: A tornado touched down in Adams and moved northeast touching down several times.  Several buildings were damaged or destroyed.  Many trees uprooted.  A church in Adams lost its steeple and bell tower.

ncei:10335033.title: Clubb, Missouri
ncei:10335033.narrative: A brief tornado lasting about one minute damaged a pole barn in Clubb.  A one-room attachment to the barn was blown off.  Trees were blown down from Clubb to two miles east of Clubb.

ncei:10355157.title: Pleasant View, Utah
ncei:10355157.narrative: As a cold front pushed through northern Utah, a tornado is thought to have moved through Pleasant View.   Witnesses described a freight train sound, and the damage was in a hit or miss fashion.  Damage included a 12 to 18-inch diameter tree that was snapped (not uprooted), shingles blown off of several roofs, windows and doors damaged on two homes under construction, three large pine trees nearly uprooted, and a destroyed metal shed.  The width of the tornado was unknown.

ncei:10349429.title: Rutherford, Tennessee
ncei:10349429.narrative: Six homes and two business were destroyed.  Fifty other houses and business were damaged.  Numerous trees were knocked down as well.

ncei:10349511.title: Maryville, Tennessee
ncei:10349511.narrative: The tornado that went through Loudon County continued across Blount County through the town of Friendsville and ending just west of Maryville.  One large home was destroyed and several other were damaged.  Numerous trees were snapped.

ncei:10351387.title: Aubrey, Texas
ncei:10351387.narrative: A tornado touched down on a ranch east of Aubrey on Farm-to-Market Road 1385.  The ranch house, several barns, an apartment, and a mobile home were destroyed.  A man was seriously injured from flying debris.
